name: LearnTube AI
tagline: Turn any YouTube lesson into notes, practice, and a revision plan.
description: LearnTube AI turns a captioned YouTube video or pasted transcript into a complete, saved study workspace. Generate source-grounded notes, flashcards, quizzes, action steps, a topic roadmap, and mentor answers; track recall and weak concepts; and export a one-page cheat sheet. Lessons and progress sync through Anna Storage, while generation uses the learner's Anna model access—no separate model API key is required.
changelog: Production audit hardening: verifies the reviewed YouTube URL through the bundled transcript helper, keeps both Agent permission submodes saveable, preserves the three product screenshots, and guarantees useful actions, roadmap, cheat-sheet, and mentor prompts even when a model response reaches its output limit.
